title: Workout Planner Gym Log・Fit AI
description:
FitAI is an AI workout planner, gym log and workout tracker in one fitness app. Get a personalized workout plan from your AI personal trainer, log every set at the gym or at home, and build muscle, lose weight and get stronger with 3000+ exercises and a Wear OS app.

Join 9M+ people who plan, track and log their workouts with FitAI.

AI WORKOUT PLANNER & PERSONAL TRAINER
• Get a personalized workout plan built around your goal, fitness level and the equipment you have.
• Build muscle, lose weight, gain strength or improve your overall fitness: your AI workout planner adapts to your goal.
• Ask your AI personal trainer about exercises, training and recovery and get instant answers.
• Plans for the gym, home workouts and full body routines for every level.

GYM LOG & WORKOUT TRACKER
• Log sets, reps and weights in seconds with a simple gym log.
• Track your progress with detailed charts, workout history and personal records.
• Use the workout tracker to apply progressive overload and keep getting stronger.
• Celebrate new personal records and fitness milestones.

HOME WORKOUTS & GYM WORKOUTS
• Home workouts with no equipment: bodyweight and calisthenics exercises you can do anywhere.
• Dumbbell, kettlebell and resistance band training at home.
• Gym workouts with barbells, dumbbells, kettlebells and other equipment.
• Create your own split: push pull legs, upper/lower or full body workout.

3000+ EXERCISES WITH VIDEO
• Gym and bodyweight exercises for every muscle group: chest, back, shoulders, biceps, triceps, abs, quads, hamstrings, glutes, calves and forearms.
• Clear exercise videos with text cues for proper form.
• Ready-made routines that target specific muscle groups: abs workouts, chest, arms, legs and glutes.

STRENGTH TRAINING, HIIT & WEIGHT LOSS
• Strength training and weight lifting programs to build muscle.
• HIIT, cardio and fat burning workouts to lose weight.
• Running, cycling, stretching, yoga and foam rolling sessions for recovery and mobility.

WORKOUTS FOR MEN, WOMEN & BEGINNERS
• Workout plans for men and women, personalized to your goal.
• Beginner workouts with video guides, plus advanced training for experienced lifters.
• Muscle building and bodybuilding plans for gym lovers.

WEAR OS WORKOUT TRACKER
• Log your training from your Wear OS watch and sync live with your phone.
• Real-time heart rate, rest timer alerts and a home screen tile for your current workout.

WHY FITAI
FitAI brings a personal trainer, workout planner, workout tracker, gym log and exercise library together in one fitness app. Train smarter with AI, stay consistent and reach your fitness goals faster.

FAQ
Is FitAI free to download?
Yes. Download FitAI for free and start training. An optional subscription unlocks premium features.
Can I work out at home without equipment?
Yes. Choose home workouts with bodyweight exercises, or tell FitAI which equipment you have and get a plan built around it.
Does FitAI work with Wear OS?
Yes. The Wear OS app logs your workouts, shows your heart rate and syncs with your phone.
Can I create my own workout routine?
Yes. Build custom workouts and splits from 3000+ exercises, or start from a ready-made plan.
Is FitAI good for beginners?
Yes. Plans cover every level, from beginners to advanced athletes.
Does FitAI track my progress?
Yes. Your gym log saves every set, rep and weight and shows your progress in charts and personal records.

Download FitAI, your AI workout planner and gym log, and start your personalized workout plan today.

Disclaimer: The FitAI app is not affiliated with any other workout planner, workout tracker, gym log or fitness apps like; Hevy, Jefit, Strong, Fitbud, Fitbit, my fitness pal, Heavyset or 5x5.

title: BodBot AI Personal Trainer
description:
BodBot – Better AI, Better Workouts. 

Your Own AI-Powered Personal Trainer
BodBot delivers hyper-personalized workouts tailored to your goals, equipment, fitness level, and schedule. Whether you're training at home, in the gym, or on the go, our cutting-edge AI adapts every workout in real time to maximize progress, efficiency, and results.

Train Smarter, Progress Faster
- AI-driven customization: Your workouts evolve based on performance, recovery, and even skipped sessions.
- Results on your terms: Build muscle, gain strength, boost endurance, or burn fat with workouts designed for your unique body.
- Anytime, anywhere: No gym? No problem. Train with bodyweight or equipment and get expert-level programming wherever you are.

Intelligent Adaptation & Real-Time Adjustments
- Adaptive progression: Your training plan intelligently adjusts reps, sets, weight, and intensity to keep you progressing.
- Lifestyle-aware workouts: Your plan adapts to your daily activity levels, sleep, and real-world schedule.
- Seamless structure: Get balanced programming with circuits, supersets, and strategic recovery for maximum efficiency.

Personalized Coaching & Exercise Guidance
- Step-by-step instruction: Every movement is explained in detail with detailed instructions and demo videos.
- Smart mobility & strength assessments: Unlock better movement patterns and target weak points with precision.
- Your plan, your feedback: No cookie-cutter workouts. Adjust difficulty and focus areas as you train.

BodBot: The AI Trainer That Works For You
You don’t need to figure out what to do—BodBot does it for you. Whether you’re a beginner or advanced lifter, every workout is optimized for maximum impact.

Tight hamstrings? Shoulder mobility issues? Specific muscle imbalances? BodBot identifies, adjusts, and helps you improve.

And if you miss a session or add extra activity, your plan will automatically update to keep you on track.

Your fitness, reimagined. Ready to train smarter? Download BodBot today.

title: Fitness Coach: Weight Loss
description:
Fitness Coach is your ultimate fitness app for effective weight loss and muscle building—whether you prefer home workouts, training with no equipment, or using gym gear. You can target any body part you want and enjoy personalized workout plans designed by experts in this exercise app to help reach your goals.

The brilliant part? No matter your fitness level, you can dive into your special daily routine anytime, anywhere— no equipment or coach needed. What is more, you can find effective and time-efficient sweat sessions as short as 2 minutes.

Fitness Coach also ensures you can make the most of workouts by providing animations, video guidance, and all your well-being data.

Use our fitness app developed by the famous fitness developer to get your workout plan, pursue your fitness goals and witness your success together with millions of happy LEAP users.

Fantastic Features Designed for You:

🏃‍♂️ Special workout plans and training programs according to your fitness goal
🏠 Bodyweight workout at home with no equipment needed
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Beginner, intermediate and advanced level to match your needs
🎓 100+ various workouts designed by experts
🎥 Professional coach or animation video guidance
📊 Your individual data tracking chart
💬 Sharing your fitness journey with friends

✨Customize home workout for you
Don't know how to choose workouts? Let our exercise app create your ideal workout plan. You will find your fit from 100+ workouts and explore trending choices—from HIIT to dumbbell workouts and stretching sessions.

✨Challenge yourself with 30-day plans
Take on your 30-day plan tailored by experts and adjusted to your feedback. You can blast calories, boost the immune system and so on by 9 types of plans. With prebuilt rest days and different exercises, your training stays balanced and effective.

✨Get targeted support at every level
Whether you are a beginner or a fitness expert, you will get a routine that matches your ability. You can choose different plan levels to increase the difficulty and challenge yourself.

✨Train anywhere and anytime with no equipment
We provide flexible bodyweight workouts that fit perfectly into your busy life. From 2-minute routines to full workouts over 30 minutes, you can build healthy habits wherever you are.

✨Exercise with professional guidance
You can follow along with expert coaches through voice and video guidance. Every workout plan includes detailed instruction and preparation tips to ensure correct form, prevent injuries, and improve your workout efficiency.

✨Know your fitness journey thoroughly
Your latest stats, including steps, water intake, weight, workouts, and calories burned, are shown daily, weekly, and monthly to help you stay on track. You can also sync your data with Google Fit.

✨Be inspired by sharing your progress
Fitness is better together! Every milestone—big or small—can be celebrated and cheered by your friends. Share your happiness and enjoy every win along the way!

Now it is time to go start crushing your goals and download Fitness Coach today!

title: The Body Coach: Workout Plans
description:
Transform your fitness with The Body Coach app by Joe Wicks - the all-in-one workout & fitness app packed with quick home workout sessions, HIIT workouts, pilates and yoga for beginners as well as a personalised meal planner and daily progress tools to keep you motivated. 

It’s transformed the lives of millions of people and has been awarded the ‘2022 App of the Year’ by Google and ‘Editor's Choice’ by Apple.  

WHY THE BODY COACH? 
- Home workout & meal prep app in one tidy place - no gym membership, no expensive kit.   
- Our smart workout planner builds a phased fitness plan around your level, schedule and goals. 
- The built-in meal planner keeps healthy eating simple, tasty and sustainable. 
- Progress tools (photos, measurements) keep you accountable and help you track your weight loss. 
- Vibrant community & live fitness challenges mean you’re never training alone. 

A STRUCTURED FITNESS APP 
- Our phased approach keeps you improving month after month, with plans for every experience level: 
- Beginner – build confidence with 20-minute, low-impact home workouts 
- Intermediate – mix strength, cardio & pilates to boost endurance 
- Advanced – power, pace and progressive overload 
- Advanced+ – intense splits for experienced athletes 
- Every phase includes warm-ups, cool-downs and technique tutorials so you train safely and effectively. 

CLASSES & WORKOUTS 
From high-intensity to quiet, apartment-friendly workouts: 
- HIIT 
- Strength training      
- Yoga  
- Mobility & flexibility  
- Ab workouts 
- Bodyweight and Dumbbell workout    
- Stretching 

Current beginner-friendly series add variety to your at-home fitness plan: 
- Menopause and perimenopause workouts 
- Pilates series  
- Low impact exercise 

MEAL PLANNER & NUTRITION TRACKER 
- 1000+ recipes - mixed, pescatarian, vegetarian, vegan. 
- Weekly shopping lists and batch-cook tags for easy meal prep. 
- High-protein meals,  snacks, energy-boosting breakfasts, and family-size portions. 
- Fresh dishes drop every 30 days plus seasonal specials. 

COMMUNITY & LIVE CHALLENGES 
- Join live classes and fitness challenges. 
- Swap tips on meal prep, low-impact exercise and more. 
- Celebrate milestones in a supportive, judgment-free space in our Facebook community group. 

TECH THAT FITS YOUR LIFE 
- Watch classes away from home whether you’re in a hotel room or doing a garden workout. 
- Chromecast support for big-screen sessions. 

COACHING TEAM 
Founded by best-selling trainer Joe Wicks, The Body Coach now features a range of instructors. 

SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS 
The Body Coach offers auto-renewing monthly and annual plans. Manage or cancel any time in your Google Play account settings (turn off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period).

It’s transformed the lives of millions of people and has been awarded the ‘2022 App of the Year’ by Google and ‘Editor's Choice’ by Apple.

WHY THE BODY COACH?
- Home workout & meal prep app in one tidy place - no gym membership, no expensive kit.
- Our smart workout planner builds a phased fitness plan around your level, schedule and goals.
- The built-in meal planner keeps healthy eating simple, tasty and sustainable.
- Progress tools (photos, measurements) keep you accountable and help you track your weight loss.
- Vibrant community & live fitness challenges mean you’re never training alone.

A STRUCTURED FITNESS APP
- Our phased approach keeps you improving month after month, with plans for every experience level:
- Beginner – build confidence with 20-minute, low-impact home workouts
- Intermediate – mix strength, cardio & pilates to boost endurance
- Advanced – power, pace and progressive overload
- Advanced+ – intense splits for experienced athletes
- Every phase includes warm-ups, cool-downs and technique tutorials so you train safely and effectively.

CLASSES & WORKOUTS
From high-intensity to quiet, apartment-friendly workouts:
- HIIT
- Strength training     
- Yoga
- Mobility & flexibility 
- Ab workouts
- Bodyweight and Dumbbell workout   
- Stretching

Current beginner-friendly series add variety to your at-home fitness plan:
- Menopause and perimenopause workouts
- Pilates series
- Low impact exercise

MEAL PLANNER & NUTRITION TRACKER
- 1000+ recipes - mixed, pescatarian, vegetarian, vegan.
- Weekly shopping lists and batch-cook tags for easy meal prep.
- High-protein meals, snacks, energy-boosting breakfasts, and family-size portions.
- Fresh dishes drop every 30 days plus seasonal specials.

COMMUNITY & LIVE CHALLENGES
- Join live classes and fitness challenges.
- Swap tips on meal prep, low-impact exercise and more.
- Celebrate milestones in a supportive, judgment-free space in our Facebook community group.

TECH THAT FITS YOUR LIFE
- Watch classes away from home whether you’re in a hotel room or doing a garden workout.
- Chromecast support for big-screen sessions.

COACHING TEAM
Founded by best-selling trainer Joe Wicks, The Body Coach now features a range of instructors.

SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS
The Body Coach offers auto-renewing monthly and annual plans. Manage or cancel any time in your Google Play account settings (turn off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period).

title: FitnessAI: Gym Workout Planner
description:
Workout at home or at the gym with FitnessAI’s advanced training algorithm to guide you through the perfect set, rep and weight combination to reach your fitness goals.
 
● Get results with whatever equipment you have available to you. Whether your fitness goals are to build muscle, get toned or lose weight fast, FitnessAI is the simplest way to access a world class training regiment.
 
● Our easy to follow gym and home workouts are backed by data, not intuition. FitnessAI’s simple layout allows for easy exercise tracking for your full body workout.
 
● FitnessAI plans your gym sessions and optimizing for health, strength and fitness. It’s algorithm offers high rep modes to help you get toned, as well as advanced progressive overload optimizations to help you build mass while weight lifting. Get stronger, faster at home or the gym.

● Your personal trainer in your pocket offers the most effective gym / home exercises  that target your back, biceps, chest, triceps, shoulder, legs, core workouts and weight lifting ab exercises. Specializing in both beginner weight lifting exercises and advance strength training techniques, FitnessAI is sure to help you at the gym.
 
● The best weight lifting app / best weightlifting gym routine designed by weightlifters, for weightlifters. Based on 5.9M workouts, our innovative algorithm is sure to out-perform any human personal trainer or fitness coach at the gym. Not to mention, it’s a fraction of the cost, and smarter! Finally a weight lifting app that does what a weight lifting app is meant to do!
 
● Optimized gym workouts make your weight lifting routine as efficient as possible at the gym. Our gym routine is top notch and sure to help you get stronger, and reach your fitness goals
 
● Set your mind on a workout or fitness goal and let Fitness AI do the rest. Smart exercise planner schedules weightlifting exercises on a better schedule than common 5x5 routines. Whether you’re lifting with free weights, barbells or machines, FitnessAI’s gym log and tracker is sure to exceed your weight lifting expectations.
 
● A personalized weight lifting plan to get you leaner, stronger or bigger, faster than any personal trainer or fitness coach you find at the gym. Build your workout based on your strength-training history. Log your exercises and FitnessAI’s algorithm will do the rest.
 
● Fitness AI builds you a personalized daily weight lifting and cardio plan that pushes you to your limits at the gym
 
● Fitness AI automatically optimizes weight lifting sets, reps and weights for each exercise every time you work out — pushing you the perfect amount to build muscle efficiently. Much better than a gym trainer!
 
● Our algorithm is based on 40k weight lifters and gym goers over a 3-year period — one of the largest weightlifting datasets in the world.
 
● Our personalized weightlifting routine is balanced and boosts major muscle groups. Toggle between weight lifting workouts each day at the gym.
 
● Weight lifting schedule incredibly easy to use ― focus on your fitness workout not your phone (or your gym trainer).

title: Calorii: Workouts & Nutrition
description:
Calorii is the complete all-in-one fitness app designed to help you stay consistent and achieve real results.
It creates a personalized fitness experience based on your goals, preferences, and lifestyle, then adapts as you progress. From planning and tracking to training and insights, everything works together in one simple, powerful app.

Check in after 1 week and use the built-in AI body scan to adjust your workouts and nutrition. Along the way, track everything in detail (weight, body measurements, and composition) and stay motivated with leaderboards and challenges.

HOW CALORII APP – AI FITNESS TRAINER WORKS:

01 Tell Us About You ℹ️
Quick setup. Answer a few questions about your goals, fitness level, and preferences to start your journey with your ai personal trainer. Whether you need a beginner workout or a complex gym fitness workout, we build a foundation just for you.

02. Get Your Plan 📅
Receive a personalized workout schedule and meal plan fully tailored to you. Use our ai workout planner and gym routine planner to access unlimited flexibility, serving as your custom gym workout planner for any environment.

03. Transform Daily 📈
Follow your plan, track effortlessly, and watch real results happen.

WHAT YOU’LL GET WITH CALORII AI PERSONAL TRAINER & NUTRITIONIST

🥗 Personalized Meal Plans
Say yes to meals built around your goals, preferences, and lifestyle. Calorii functions as your AI nutritionist and AI nutrition coach, helping you build sustainable habits.
• Auto-generated meal plans
• Unlimited meal options and swaps
• Global cuisines and diet styles
• Full recipes with meal calorie calculator and macro breakdowns
• Generate meals with ingredients you already have 

📱 Smart Calorie & Macro Tracking
Track nutrition in seconds. Our nutrition tracker and food tracker for weight loss makes it easy to count calories to lose weight.
• Simple calorie counter for snap, voice, or text logging
• Food Database and Barcode scanner Powered by fatsecret nutrition API (www.fatsecret.com)
• AI nutrition tracker for auto-adjusting macro targets
• Water and activity tracking to function as your dedicated food journal for weight loss

💪Tailored Workouts
Get workouts designed for your body, level, and schedule. It’s like having a gym personal trainer trainer in your pocket.
• Home or gym-based plans
• Personalized training programs
• Progressive overload and PR tracking
• Guided exercise instructions

📊Progress Tracking & Analytics
See and understand your progress clearly with the ultimate workout fitness planner.
• Weight and body measurements
• Strength and performance tracking
• Visual progress charts
• Wearable device integration
• Progress leaderboards (global and friends)
• Invite friends to encourage and compete together in challenges
• Milestones, achievements, smart reminders for additional motivation

🧠AI Body Insights
Advanced insights to guide your transformation using AI Body insights 
• Body fat percentage estimates
• Muscle development insights
• Symmetry and change analysis
• Personalized AI feedback
• Before and After Analysis 

Calorii is more than just a fitness tracker; it is your all in one fitness app that adapts as your body changes.
Stay on track and build results that last.

✅Download Calorii and experience the best fitness app (free to start) in one powerful dieting app for weight loss and performance.

Disclaimer:
Calorii provides fitness and wellness information for general informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare professional before starting any fitness or nutrition program or before making any medical or health-related decisions.

Privacy Policy: https://calorii.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://calorii.com/terms-and-conditions

title: Muscle Monster Workout Planner
description:
Muscle Monster: Your AI Workout Planner for Home & Gym

Build muscle, lose weight, and get stronger with Muscle Monster, your smart fitness coach and personalized workout planner. Whether you're starting your fitness journey or building on your progress, discover home and gym workout routines designed for your goals, fitness level, and available equipment.

PERSONALIZED WORKOUT PLANS
No more guessing what to train next. Choose your fitness goal and preferences to get a structured workout plan that fits your lifestyle.

• Muscle-building workouts for strength and progress
• Weight loss workout plans to support your fitness goals
• Full-body workout routines for balanced training
• Beginner-friendly exercises and advanced training options
• Personalized plans for home or gym workouts

HOME & GYM WORKOUTS
Train at home, in the gym, or wherever your day takes you. Muscle Monster helps you find workouts that fit your schedule and equipment.

• Home workouts with little or no equipment
• Gym workout routines for muscle building and strength
• Bodyweight and calisthenics exercises
• Dumbbell workouts for home and gym training
• Upper-body, lower-body, abs, and full-body workouts

Whether you prefer short home sessions or a structured gym workout routine, you can train your way.

DUMBBELL & STRENGTH TRAINING
Build strength with guided dumbbell workouts and personalized training routines. Explore exercises for your chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs, and core. Follow clear exercise demonstrations and work toward better consistency, whether you're using dumbbells at home or equipment at the gym.

WEIGHT LOSS, ABS & FULL-BODY FITNESS
Looking for effective weight loss workout plans or ways to strengthen your core? Explore full-body training, abs exercises, and fitness routines that support an active lifestyle.

Combine strength workouts with regular movement to build healthier habits. Choose exercises based on your goals rather than following a one-size-fits-all program.

YOUR SMART AI FITNESS COACH
Make workout planning simpler with AI-powered training recommendations. Share your goals, fitness level, and preferences to get a personalized plan suited to your needs.

From choosing your next workout to following a daily training routine, Muscle Monster helps you stay focused on what matters: showing up and making progress.

300+ EXERCISES & 200+ WORKOUTS
Discover an extensive exercise library for different muscle groups, training environments, and fitness goals.

• Guided exercise demonstrations and instructions
• Bodyweight, dumbbell, and gym exercises
• Strength, core, and full-body workout options
• Routines for beginners and experienced users

Explore new movements, find workouts that suit your equipment, and build confidence with every session.

21-DAY WORKOUT CHALLENGE
Build a more consistent routine with a structured 21-day workout challenge. Follow your plan, complete training sessions, and develop habits you can continue beyond the challenge.

TRACK YOUR WORKOUT PROGRESS
Keep your fitness journey organized. Record completed workouts, review your training history, and follow your progress over time. Small steps add up when you stick with a routine.

GET STARTED WITH MUSCLE MONSTER
1. Choose your fitness goal: build muscle, lose weight, or improve strength.
2. Share your fitness level and personal preferences.
3. Select home or gym training and your available equipment.
4. Follow your personalized workout plan.
5. Track your workouts and keep moving toward your goals.

Muscle Monster brings home workouts, gym training, dumbbell routines, and smart fitness planning together in one app.

Train at home. Get stronger at the gym. Find a workout routine that works for you.
